Refund_not_showing_up: Refunds typically take 5-10 business days to process and appear in your account from the date the merchant initiated it. Please confirm with the merchant that the refund was successfully processed and obtain a reference number or date. If you have this information and it's been more than 10 business days, please contact us directly so we can investigate further.
activate_my_card: You can typically activate your new card by logging into your online banking account, using our mobile app, or by calling the automated activation number provided on the card or in your welcome packet. If you encounter any issues or need further assistance, please contact us directly.
age_limit: Parents or legal guardians can open a junior savings account for a child of any age. To open an account independently or access full banking services, an individual must typically be 16 or 18 years old, depending on the specific product and account features.
apple_pay_or_google_pay: Apple Pay, Google Pay, and smartwatch payments function as digital wallets for making purchases using your linked debit or credit card. They do not allow you to directly deposit funds into your bank account or top up a separate card. To deposit money or top up your card, please use your bank's mobile app, online banking, or an ATM.
atm_support: You can use your card at most ATMs worldwide, including those that display the Visa, Mastercard, or Plus logos. These networks ensure broad acceptance for cash withdrawals and other transactions.
automatic_top_up: You can set up automatic top-ups to your account through your online banking portal or mobile app. This feature allows you to manage the frequency, amounts, and any applicable limits will be displayed during the setup process.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: International transfers typically take 3-5 business days to process due to varying banking procedures and time zones. To help us investigate, please provide the exact amount, date, sender's name, and any unique transaction reference numbers. You can also often view your recent transaction history within your online banking portal.
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Cash deposits are typically available instantly or within a few hours, whereas check deposits usually take 2-5 business days to clear and be reflected in your available balance. This allows time for the funds to be verified and processed through the banking system.
beneficiary_not_allowed: Transfers can be blocked due to insufficient funds, exceeding daily limits, security holds, or temporary technical issues. A beneficiary might be denied if their account details are incorrect, their bank is unsupported, or due to ongoing regulatory compliance checks.
cancel_transfer: Once a transfer or payment is processed, it generally cannot be cancelled or reversed directly by the bank. Please contact us immediately by phone so we can investigate the transaction's status and advise on any potential options, as timing is critical.
card_about_to_expire: Your new card is usually sent automatically before your current one expires, requiring no action from your side. While express delivery or international shipping for a replacement card can be arranged, please note these may involve additional fees, varying delivery times, and potential country-specific restrictions.
card_acceptance: Your card is widely accepted globally at millions of merchants and ATMs that display its payment network logo, such as Visa or Mastercard. To confirm acceptance, simply look for your card's specific logo at the point of sale or on a business's website. While uncommon, very small businesses or older terminals may occasionally have limited card type acceptance.
card_arrival: Standard card delivery typically takes 5-7 business days, and unfortunately, tracking is not available for this service. If your card has not arrived after 10 business days, please contact us to arrange for a replacement to be sent.
card_delivery_estimate: While we cannot guarantee specific delivery dates, standard card delivery usually takes 7-10 business days. If you need your card sooner, expedited shipping options may be available for an additional fee; please contact us directly to discuss these arrangements.
card_linking: If you found a card you previously reported lost, it has likely been canceled, so please activate your replacement card instead. For a brand new card, activate the physical card first, then go to the card management section in your app to add it by following the on-screen prompts.
card_not_working: I understand your card isn't working and that can be very frustrating. To determine the exact reason your card was declined or isn't functioning, we'll need to securely access your account and review recent transaction attempts or any active holds. Please log into your online banking or contact us directly to investigate this further.
card_payment_fee_charged: Fees for card payments typically stem from foreign transaction charges, currency conversions when paying in a different currency, or surcharges applied by the merchant. To understand a specific fee, please check your statement details or refer to your card's terms and conditions.
card_payment_not_recognised: If you see an unfamiliar payment, it's crucial to report it immediately so we can investigate and protect your account. Please contact our support team or use the dispute function in your online banking or app to begin the fraud investigation process.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Exchange rates can fluctuate daily and typically include a small margin from the card network or bank, which may differ from official interbank rates. You can view the exact exchange rate applied to your specific transaction in your online banking statement; if you still have concerns, please let us know.
card_swallowed: If an ATM retained your card, first, do not leave the machine immediately as it may still eject it after a brief moment. If it doesn't, please contact us immediately to block your card and prevent any unauthorized transactions. We will then assist you with ordering a replacement card.
cash_withdrawal_charge: ATM withdrawal fees typically occur when you use an ATM outside of your bank's network or one that is independently owned. These charges are levied by the ATM operator, and you are usually notified of the fee on screen before completing your transaction.
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: An unrecognized cash withdrawal is a serious concern that requires immediate attention. Please contact us directly through secure channels, such as your online banking portal or our customer service line, so we can thoroughly investigate the transaction details and initiate a dispute if it's unauthorized.
change_pin: You can typically change your PIN through your bank's online banking portal or by requesting a new one to be mailed to your registered address. While some ATMs allow PIN activation, it is generally not possible to change your PIN to a number of your choosing at any cash machine.
compromised_card: We take potential fraud very seriously. To protect your account, we can immediately block your card and begin an investigation into the unrecognized transactions. Please confirm which charges you dispute so we can formally open a fraud claim and guide you through the resolution process.
contactless_not_working: Before trying to uninstall your app, please ensure your card isn't expired and NFC is enabled on your phone for mobile payments. If it's your physical card, try a chip and PIN transaction first to verify it's active. If contactless payments still aren't working, please contact us for further assistance.
country_support: We currently offer banking services and card issuance to residents of the European Economic Area (EEA) and the UK. While account opening is limited to these regions, our cards are accepted globally wherever Visa or Mastercard is supported for purchases and ATM withdrawals.
declined_card_payment: Card declines often occur due to reasons like insufficient funds, an inactive or expired card, or security measures detecting unusual activity. To get specific details on why your recent payment was declined and resolve the issue, please check your account online or contact us directly.
declined_cash_withdrawal: Declines can happen for a few common reasons, like insufficient funds, exceeding your daily withdrawal limit, or a temporary security hold on your card. To understand the specific reason for your recent transaction decline and to resolve it, please check your mobile banking app or contact us directly.
declined_transfer: Declined transactions commonly occur due to insufficient funds, exceeding daily spending limits, or for security purposes to protect your account from potential fraud. For specific details regarding your particular decline, please review your account activity or contact us directly to investigate the unique decline code.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: Please contact us directly via secure message, phone, or by visiting a branch for any unrecognized payments or direct debits, including older transactions. We will investigate these items, help identify the payee, and guide you through the appropriate steps to dispute a transaction or cancel an unauthorized direct debit.
disposable_card_limits: Disposable virtual cards are single-use for enhanced security during online transactions and do not carry additional restrictions beyond the amount you choose to load onto them. You can instantly generate new ones directly through your online banking or mobile app whenever needed.
edit_personal_details: You can update your personal details by logging into your online banking, visiting a branch, or contacting us directly. Please be prepared to provide relevant documentation, such as a marriage certificate for name changes or proof of address.
exchange_charge: Currency exchange transactions typically involve a service fee, which will be clearly disclosed to you upfront without any hidden charges. We prioritize transparency, ensuring all costs are presented before you confirm any exchange. Frequent exchangers or specific account holders may be eligible for preferential rates or reduced fees based on their banking relationship.
exchange_rate: The value of your money abroad is determined by the current foreign exchange rate, which fluctuates continuously based on global market conditions. We can provide you with the exact exchange rate applicable at the time of your transaction, regardless of whether it's a weekday or weekend.
exchange_via_app: Yes, you can exchange between a wide range of currencies, such as AUD to GBP, USD to GBP, and many others, directly within our app. Simply select the account holding the currency you wish to convert and choose the desired target currency to initiate the exchange.
extra_charge_on_statement: Small charges on your statement often relate to foreign transaction fees for purchases made in a different currency, or ATM fees from non-bank ATMs. To determine the exact reason, please review the full transaction details on your statement or mobile app, or provide us with the date and merchant for personalized assistance.
failed_transfer: We understand your frustration with the failed transfers. This can happen for various reasons such as incorrect details, exceeding limits, or security measures, and doesn't always indicate a system-wide issue. To investigate the specific cause of your transaction failures and provide a resolution, we will need to review your transfer attempts.
fiat_currency_support: You can hold money in up to 15 different currencies and easily exchange between them within your account. We support a wide range of major currencies for these exchanges, including EUR, USD, and GBP.
get_disposable_virtual_card: Disposable virtual cards enhance your security for online purchases by providing temporary card details that expire after a single use or a set period, protecting your primary account information. You can typically generate these cards through your bank's mobile app or online banking portal, usually found in the cards or security settings section.
get_physical_card: Your PIN is always sent in a separate mailing from your card for security reasons. If you haven't received it or need a new one, you can easily request a replacement through your online banking, mobile app, or by contacting us directly. This will generate and send you a new PIN.
getting_spare_card: You can order an additional card for yourself or an authorized user directly through your online banking portal or by speaking with an agent. While many additional cards are complimentary, any potential charges or specific eligibility requirements will be detailed during the ordering process or can be confirmed by checking your account's terms and conditions.
getting_virtual_card: You can easily order a virtual card through our mobile banking app or by logging into your online banking account and navigating to the 'Cards' or 'Virtual Cards' section. As virtual cards are digital, they are instantly available for use within the app or online banking and are not physically mailed.
lost_or_stolen_card: I understand this is stressful. Let's immediately secure your account by blocking your lost or stolen card to prevent any unauthorized activity. Once blocked, we can review recent transactions together, and I'll help you order a replacement card right away.
lost_or_stolen_phone: Immediately report your bank cards as stolen or freeze them through your banking app or by calling us, to prevent any unauthorized transactions. Next, contact your mobile carrier to report the device stolen, and change passwords for critical accounts like email and social media.
order_physical_card: You can easily request a physical card through your mobile app or online banking, or by contacting our support team directly. Standard physical cards are typically free of charge and will be delivered to your registered address within a few business days.
passcode_forgotten: If you've forgotten your password or passcode, please use the "Forgot Password" or "Reset Passcode" link available on our app or website login screen. This process will guide you through identity verification steps to securely regain access to your account.
pending_card_payment: A pending payment means the transaction has been authorized by your bank but is still being processed by the merchant before it's officially debited from your account. This is a normal stage and doesn't indicate an issue; the funds are typically held for the merchant to complete their processing, usually within 2-3 business days.
pending_cash_withdrawal: Cash withdrawals, whether from an ATM or a teller, typically appear as "pending" until the end of the business day or the next business day while our systems finalize the transaction. This is a normal processing step to ensure all records are accurately updated, and it will reflect as completed soon.
pending_top_up: Top-ups and deposits typically process instantly, but can take up to 1-3 business days to reflect depending on the sending bank and payment method, especially over weekends or public holidays. If your funds haven't appeared within this period, please check your transaction details and contact our support team.
pending_transfer: Funds typically take 1-3 business days to process and appear in your account; international transfers like SEPA can take up to 2 working days, and SWIFT transfers up to 5 working days. Please ensure your account details were entered correctly, as incorrect information can cause delays in funds clearing.
pin_blocked: For security reasons, exceeding the number of PIN attempts will temporarily lock your card. You will need to request a new PIN to be mailed to your registered address, or visit your nearest branch with valid ID for immediate assistance.
receiving_money: Yes, you can receive your salary directly into your account by providing your employer with your account number and sort code. There's no need to configure anything in the app for GBP payments; they will be credited to your account automatically in GBP.
request_refund: For refunds, returns, or cancellations, please contact the merchant directly as they manage product policies and processing times. If you have already contacted the merchant and a valid refund has not been received after their stated period, we can assist by initiating a dispute on your behalf.
reverted_card_payment?: If your payment initially appeared to go through but was later returned, this often indicates a security hold, a merchant processing issue, or a pre-authorization that was not finalized. For the exact reason your specific transaction was declined or reverted, please contact us directly with the payment details so we can securely investigate your account.
supported_cards_and_currencies: We do not currently support American Express or other credit card top-ups; instead, you can add money to your account using a debit card or by initiating a bank transfer. We accept funds in major currencies including USD, EUR, and GBP.
terminate_account: You can close your account by first ensuring your balance is zero and all direct debits or standing orders are cancelled. Once that's done, please contact our support team or visit a branch to complete the account deactivation process.
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: There are no fees for sending or receiving SEPA transfers with us. This means you will not be charged when topping up your account using a SEPA transfer.
top_up_by_card_charge: Topping up your card with a debit card is typically free, but a fee may apply if you use a credit card. When using your card for purchases abroad, such as in the US, foreign transaction or currency conversion fees may also apply depending on your card's terms.
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Yes, you can deposit cheques by mailing them to our designated processing centre. Ensure your account number and sort code are clearly written on the back of the cheque before sending it. You can find the correct mailing address on our website or by contacting us directly.
top_up_failed: A failed top-up can occur due to a temporary processing delay or an issue with the payment method. Please check your transaction history and card statement for any pending charges, as funds are typically returned within a few minutes if unsuccessful. If the issue persists, please ensure your card details are correct before trying again.
top_up_limits: Daily and monthly limits apply to top-ups to ensure account security, meaning you cannot top-up unlimited or arbitrary amounts. You can view your current limits and often request an increase through your online banking portal or by contacting us directly.
top_up_reverted: Missing or cancelled top-ups often result from processing delays or issues with the recipient's system. Please review your transaction history to confirm the status and check for any debits or corresponding refund notifications. If the issue persists, we can investigate further.
topping_up_by_card: For missing funds or top-ups, please check your recent transaction history in your online banking or app. If you're looking to send money, credit cards are primarily for purchases or cash advances, not direct transfers, but you can typically transfer funds from a linked bank account.
transaction_charged_twice: We understand your concern about duplicate charges on your account. Often, one charge is a temporary authorization that will automatically drop off within a few business days. If both charges post to your account or you need immediate assistance, please provide the transaction details so we can investigate further.
transfer_fee_charged: Transfer fees commonly apply to certain transaction types, such as international transfers, wire transfers, or expedited services, which often involve different banking networks or currency conversions. You can view the specific fee and its reason within your transaction details in online banking or by checking your account's fee schedule for that particular transfer method.
transfer_into_account: You can transfer money from your account using online banking or our mobile app by selecting the recipient and amount. To transfer money into your account or link it with another bank or service, provide your account and routing numbers. Always verify the specific process and required details within your online banking portal or the external service you are using.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Bank transfers typically process within 1-3 business days, with exact timing dependent on the banks involved, time of day, and if a weekend or holiday impacts processing. While a pending status for a few hours is common, if it has been several business days or the recipient's bank confirms non-receipt, please check your transaction history for more details or contact us for further assistance.
transfer_timing: International bank transfers typically take 1-5 business days to process, though this can vary based on the sending and receiving banks, countries involved, and currency. Weekends, public holidays, and daily cut-off times can also affect when funds become available in your account.
unable_to_verify_identity: We typically require a valid government-issued photo ID like a passport or driver's license, and sometimes proof of address, to verify your identity. Rejection can occur if documents are expired, details don't match our records, or images are unclear, even if factual. If you're experiencing difficulties, please ensure all information is current and clearly legible, and contact us for further assistance.
verify_my_identity: To verify your identity, we generally require a valid government-issued photo ID like a driver's license or passport. Depending on the service you need, this can typically be done securely online by submitting your documents, or in person at any of our branch locations. This process helps us protect your account from unauthorized access.
verify_source_of_funds: You can view the specific source of funds deposited into your account by checking your transaction history, accessible through online banking, our mobile app, or on your monthly statements. These records detail incoming transactions, showing information like the sender, type of deposit, and date.
verify_top_up: You can verify your top-up by checking your account's transaction history or statement, which will show the successful deposit and updated balance. There isn't a separate code for verifying a completed top-up; its appearance in your transaction log confirms it.
virtual_card_not_working: Disposable virtual cards are often designed for single-use or specific transaction types and may decline for recurring subscriptions or if already used. Please ensure sufficient funds are available and that all card details are entered correctly, as some merchants may also have restrictions on accepting certain virtual card types.
visa_or_mastercard: Yes, we offer both Visa and Mastercard options for our debit and credit cards. You can select your preferred card network during the application process or inquire with a representative about specific product availability.
why_verify_identity: We conduct identity checks to protect your account from fraud, ensure the security of your funds, and comply with strict financial regulations designed to prevent financial crime. This essential process verifies your identity, safeguarding your financial well-being and requiring specific information to meet these critical security and legal standards.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: This can happen if the ATM has a dispensing limit per transaction or lacks the specific denominations to fulfill your exact request. Please check your transaction receipt for the dispensed amount and details, then contact us directly if there is still a discrepancy for further investigation.
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Exchange rates for international cash withdrawals and transactions are often determined by the local ATM operator or processing network at the time of the transaction, which can differ from your bank's daily rate, and separate fees may also be applied by the ATM owner and your bank. For a precise breakdown of the rates and fees applied to your specific transaction, please review your transaction details and our foreign transaction fee disclosure, or contact us directly with the transaction date and amount for assistance.
